On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 15:42, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alicia — thank you for the quick heads-up and the sample. I’m very sorry you hit this during a peak window.

Quick update from triage:
- No config rollouts or model swaps recorded in the hosted control plane for FastCommerce's routing group during the window.
- We observed a short-lived increase in connection churn on a subset of WebSocket gateways in us-west-2, coinciding with a surge of ~2.1x concurrent connections around 18:05 PST.
- Autoscaler reacted but there is a ~90–120s scale-up lag for GPU-backed instances under long-lived streaming sessions; during that lag we see longer queueing at the gateway and higher per-request tails.
- I attached a 60s server log snippet showing queued request counts and slow_kv_cache hits.

Immediate mitigations in progress:
1) Throttle back burst accept rate at the gateway for transient new connections to reduce queue head-of-line blocking. (Dev taking lead)
2) Enable a temporary larger pre-warm pool for FastCommerce routing group to lower scale latency (30m warm window).
3) Add short-term retry/backoff recommendation for clients to avoid synchronized reconnect storms.

Dev — can you push the gateway throttle ASAP and share the rollout ID? We’ll coordinate on the bridge.

Rishi
SRE Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia / Daniel — following up with a summary and follow-through items after last night's event.

What happened (TL;DR):
- A rapid 2x increase in concurrent WebSocket connections during your evening peak created a temporary connection churn and head-of-line queueing on a subset of us-west-2 gateways. The autoscaler reacted but the scale-up lag for GPU-backed streaming sessions created short p99 tail regressions.

What we did:
- Deployed gateway throttle (gw-throttle-20280719-01) and pre-warmed +2 GPU slots for your routing group. Observed p99 fall back to baseline within ~4 minutes of rollout.
- Suggested client-side jittered reconnect policy to avoid synchronized reconnect storms.

Action items:
- Rishi / Dev: we will run a capacity runbook to tune the pre-warm policy for FastCommerce and evaluate reducing scale-up lag (due 2028-07-25).
- CS (Mina) + FastCommerce: schedule a short post-mortem call to review connection patterns and any client-side mitigations. Proposed slots: Mon 2028-07-23 09:00–10:00 PT or Tue 2028-07-24 16:00–17:00 PT.
- Lauren: I’ll escalate any credit/comp considerations if FastCommerce reports revenue impact.

Alicia — sorry again for the disruption. We appreciate the sample you shared; it helped speed the triage. Please let us know which post-mortem slot works best.
